import pandas as pd
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

catalog = pd.read_csv(CATALOG_CSV)
points = catalog.set_index('point_uri').to_dict('index')

times = values['timestamp']

def value_at_point_uri(point_uri, point_time):

    return values[values['timeseries_id'] == ts_id].set_index('timestamp').loc[point_time, 'value']

diff = actual - setpoint
